name: Yen's Grimoire
source:
Yen's Grimoire will put you into the boots of our cold, calculating yet dazzling sorceress as you make your choices and bear their consequences, inspired by the very choice and consequence DNA of the Witcher 3.

Yennefer is free, with no critical or dire circumstances haunting her. She is also, for better or worse, is free of the spell that bound her and Geralt's fates together. As such, once the dust from the war has settled, Yen decides to head to Vengerberg. Her home from a past that feels very distant to her now. She quickly settles into her new yet familiar lifestyle of presenting her services to the townsfolk. 

Besides her business, a beauty like Yennefer is sure to garner attention from anyone that wishes to cherish or taste this beauty. Yennefer, given her predicament, is surely willing to engage in thrills of the flesh (or not). Meet and choose to engage in whatever distractions of the flesh catches your fancy.

However, besides all the cities amusements, something else is awry in the city. Follow the trail, as you meet faces both familiar and new, and watch the mystery unfold.

Happy Trails.

[From [url=https://ephroda8.itch.io/yens-grimoire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Yen的魔法书》将让你扮演冷酷、精于算计却又令人眼花缭乱的女巫，在《巫师3》的选择和后果DNA的启发下，做出选择并承担其后果。

叶妮芙自由了，没有任何危急或可怕的情况困扰着她。无论好坏，她也摆脱了将她和杰洛特的命运绑在一起的咒语。因此，一旦战争尘埃落定，严决定前往温格伯格。她过去的家现在感觉离她很遥远。她很快就适应了新的但熟悉的生活方式，向镇民提供服务。

除了她的事业之外，像叶奈法这样的美女肯定会引起任何想要珍惜或品尝这种美丽的人的注意。考虑到叶奈法的困境，她肯定愿意（或不愿意）参与肉体的刺激。见面并选择参与任何你喜欢的肉体干扰。

然而，除了城市的所有娱乐之外，这座城市还有其他一些问题。沿着小路前进，你会遇到熟悉的和新的面孔，并观看谜团的揭开。

快乐的足迹。

[来自[url=https://ephroda8.itch.io/yens-grimoire]Itch.io[/url]]
